title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Courmayeur, Beaufort and Chamonix, 24–26 August, 2015–2025
claims: For Courmayeur, the 24–26 August window in 2015–2025 contains 33 daily records: daily maximum 17.1–32.1 °C (median 24.4 °C), daily minimum 6.0–16.8 °C (median 10.6 °C), 10 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 5 days with at least 5 mm.

For Beaufort, the same window contains 33 daily records: daily maximum 15.3–34.7 °C (median 25.0 °C), daily minimum 9.0–18.6 °C (median 13.4 °C), 10 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 6 days with at least 5 mm.

For Chamonix, the same window contains 33 daily records: daily maximum 12.8–33.5 °C (median 23.8 °C), daily minimum 7.1–18.9 °C (median 11.7 °C), 12 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 5 days with at least 5 mm.
The three locations are valley stations at roughly 1,000–1,220 m; the figures do not represent conditions at the 2,589 m high point.

verification.note: Daily values were retrieved for each coordinate and filtered to 24–26 August; medians and wet-day counts were calculated locally.

claimVerification.note: Coordinates and station elevations from the API; high point 2,589 m from the official course JSON.
